messages:
Priya Singh: FYI I spotted a weird line on the March consolidated invoice — SKU 'GPU_ATTACHMENT_FEE' applied to billing account billing-redwood-prod-apac (asia-east2). Amount ~ $11,840. No matching accelerator usage in the flat usage export. Anyone seen this before?

Mateo Rivera: Which project/showback did it attach to? Dedicated pools or hosted?

Priya Singh: Appears on the consolidated bill under project `redwood-dedicated-apac-1` (linked account). I pulled the billing export into BigQuery and the line item is odd — product = `accelerator-support`, usage_start_time = 2026-03-01. No associated resourceId.

Alice Chen: Hmm. Not a normal GCE sku name. Could be a partner/add-on marketplace charge or a misclassified reservation offset. Quick check: we didn't enable any marketplace addons in that project.

Jordan Patel: Can you paste the BQ query you ran? I'll try to join with our resource inventory.

Priya Singh: Sure — ran this to surface the rows:

```
SELECT invoice_month, project.id, sku.description, cost, usage_start_time, resource.name
FROM `billing.redwood_invoice_lines`.`gcp_raw_*`
WHERE sku.description LIKE '%ATTACHMENT%'
  AND invoice_month = '2026-03';
```

Result: one row, project.id = "redwood-dedicated-apac-1", sku.description = "GPU_ATTACHMENT_FEE", resource.name = NULL, cost = 11840.00

Mateo Rivera: That NULL resource.name is the red flag. If it was a normal per-hour SKU we'd have resource identifiers. Could be a billing adjustment or a one-off partner fee.

Priya Singh: I cross-checked commitment/discount exports — no negative offsets or credits that match that amount. Also checked the commitment_prorations table; nothing.

Alice Chen: Ops — can you grep cluster provisioning logs for March 1 for any attach/detach operations that might have generated a support fee?

ops-bot: @Alice Chen Requested logs for tag `cluster=dedicated-apac-1` between 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-02T00:00:00Z. Pull job queued (job id: pull-logs-6789).

Jordan Patel: I'm running an inventory query to map GPUs by instance id -> project for the month. If there was a cross-project attach, it should show up as an unexpected attach event.

Priya Singh: Also opening a support ticket with the provider — case #SUP-2026-004512. Mentioned it's a potential misapplied partner fee against our committed capacity. Requested a provisional reversal while they investigate.

Mateo Rivera: Good. Can we also check whether any reseller/partner label was toggled for that billing account? In the past a partner reclassification created phantom charges.

Priya Singh: Checked IAM & Marketplace settings; no marketplace listings in that billing account. Partner metadata shows partner_id = null.

Alice Chen: If provider confirms it's a partner add-on, we need to ensure our committed capacity isn't being double-billed: (1) reserve commitment credit; (2) partner surcharge. That would alter our unit economics.

Priya Singh: Filed internal ticket FIN-INV-2026-83 to hold payment for that invoice line pending provider response. Tagged @finance-leads.

billing-bot: Support case SUP-2026-004512 created with cloud provider. Estimated initial response: 24-72 hours. Reference invoice: INV-2026-03-CONSOL-23.

Jordan Patel: Quick workaround idea — if it's mapped to a specific project we can backfill a showback adjustment for March while we wait. Will need finance approval.

Priya Singh: Yes please prepare a showback note and adjustment. If provider confirms reversal we revert the adjustment.

Mateo Rivera: One more check — can someone look at the committed-use coverage report? If a reservation was migrated between projects at month boundary the billing system might have emitted an attachment fee.

Alice Chen: On it. Running CUD coverage join now.

ops-bot: Logs pulled (pull-logs-6789) — flagged 3 attach events on 2026-03-01 03:12:22Z, 03:12:24Z, 03:12:28Z for instance ids [inst-gtx-22, inst-gtx-23]. The operations indicate internal orchestrator triggered host migration between projects (orchestration-job id: orch-3321).

Jordan Patel: That orch-3321 job was a scheduled reprovision for capacity consolidation. It may have triggered billing system to consider attachments.

Priya Singh: Noted. I've appended the orchestration job id to the provider support ticket. Asked them to correlate that job timestamp with the fee.

Alice Chen: Action items: (1) ops to share the attach event detail and justification in FIN-INV-2026-83 (Jordan + Mateo). (2) Priya to escalate support ticket if no reply in 48h. (3) Finance to draft provisional showback adjustment for redwood-dedicated-apac-1.

Priya Singh: Thanks — I'll update this thread once provider responds. If anyone finds additional related lines in other months please ping me. :pray:
